title: Querying the hub from LLM agents via MCP
summary: A stdlib-only MCP stdio server (tools/mcp_server.py) exposes search, show, concept and neighbors over the hub's index and graph so Claude Code, Cursor and other MCP clients can query it as tools. The README covers client registration, a navigation path for agents (llms.txt, INDEX.md, concept pages, records.jsonl) and prompt recipes.
verified: tools/mcp_server.py ran with python3.14.7 stdlib on 2026-11-06 by piping demo_requests.jsonl into it (initialize, tools/list, tools/call for search/concept/neighbors/show, error paths); transcript shown in README. Client registration (Claude Code, Cursor, others) was not exercised.
